Script.name: Persuasion
Calculating Best Strategy
Script.script:
--Change these slightly to match your stats. --If a stat (or stats) is your highest, make it 1. --Otherwise make it slightly lower than 1. --I just went with 5% for lower ones.
PersuasionCalcDefaults = { --Ethos (Wisdom) Morality = 0.95, Authority = 0.95, Reputation = 0.95, Tradition = 0.95,
--Logos (Intelligence) Reason = 1, Evidence = 1, Analogy = 1, Causality = 1,
--Pathos (Strength) Reassurance = 1, Intimidation = 1, Inspiration = 1, Provocation = 1, }
function PersuasionCalcAdjust(boon, bane) --Reset values to defaults. PersuasionCalcs = table.deepcopy(PersuasionCalcDefaults) for appeal, value in pairs(PersuasionCalcs) do --Increase its value if it's a boon. if Persuasion.Attacks[appeal].Type == boon:title() then PersuasionCalcs[appeal] = 1.5 --Lower its value if it's a malus. elseif Persuasion.Attacks[appeal].Type == bane:title() then PersuasionCalcs[appeal] = 0.75 end end --For safety we're gonna set provocation lower. Negative effect is painful. PersuasionCalcs.Provocation = PersuasionCalcs.Provocation * 0.8 --Reputation will get a slight buff too. PersuasionCalcs.Reputation = PersuasionCalcs.Reputation * 1.1 end
function PersuasionCalcsDetermine() --Get our acumen as a percentage. local perAcu = math.floor((tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.acu)/tonumber(gmcp.Char.Vitals.maxacu))*100) local enemyAcu = math.floor((Persuasion.Target_Current_Resolve/Persuasion.Target_Max_Resolve)*100)
Persuasion.RecMorality = PersuasionMoralityCheck() --Create the basic table. local PersuasionOptions = {} --Check current appeals and add their values to be tested. for _, appeal in pairs(Persuasion.Current_Appeals) do PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionCalcs[appeal:title()] --Adjust if they have a vulnerability to the appeal type. (10% weighting should suffice) if table.contains(Persuasion.Evidence, Persuasion.Attacks[appeal:title()].Type) then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.2 end
--Check for Reassurance, if we're below 60% acument. if appeal:title() == "Reassurance" and perAcu <= 60 then --Smaller buff if it's baned. if Persuasion.Bane == "Pathos" then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.1 elseif Persuasion.Boon == "Pathos" then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.25 end end
--Buff inspiration whenever Reason is active. if appeal:title() == "Inspiration" and Persuasion.Reason then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.25 end
if appeal:title() == "Morality" and Persuasion.RecMorality then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.15 end
--Check Intimidation status. if appeal:title() == "Intimidation" and perAcu <= 55 then --Small buff if Pathos is active. More buff if Reason is active. if Persuasion.Reason then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.2 elseif Persuasion.Boon == "Pathos" then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.1 end end
--Buff Reason, with a bigger buff if Logos is booned. if appeal:title() == "Reason" and not Persuasion.Reason then if Persuasion.Boon == "Logos" then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.25 else PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.05 end end
--Buff provocation if they're low on acumen. if appeal:title() == "Provocation" and enemyAcu <= 15 then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.25 end
--Adjust now for Analogy tracking, it has the biggest buff. if Persuasion.Analogy then if Persuasion.Attacks[appeal:title()].Type ~= "Logos" then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 1.37 --Debuffed if it is Logos. else PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 0.65 end end
--If we have conflicted aff, massively lower same type appeals. if Persuasion.Affs.conflicted and Persuasion.Attacks[appeal:title()].Type == Persuasion.Last then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 0.1 end
--If we have entrenched aff, massively lower different appeal types. if Persuasion.Affs.entrenched and Persuasion.Attacks[appeal:title()].Type ~= Persuasion.Last then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] * 0.1 end
--Max tradition if we have major debuffs, or reason is active. if appeal:title() == "Tradition" then if Persuasion.Reason or Persuasion.Affs.Fatigued or Persuasion.Affs.Confounded then PersuasionOptions[appeal:title()] = 10 end end end
--Now we should iterated the adjusted table, to find the best result to use. local bestResult, bestValue = "", 0 local sameValues = {} cecho("\n") for appeal, weight in pairs(PersuasionOptions) do if weight > bestValue then --Reset same since we've found a new highest. sameValues = {} bestValue = weight bestResult = appeal table.insert(sameValues, appeal:title()) elseif weight == bestValue then table.insert(sameValues, appeal:title()) end --We'll print values purely for debugging purposes. cecho(" <DarkSlateGrey>["..appeal.."]: <DimGrey>"..weight) end --If there's only 1 result, then send that one. if #sameValues == 1 then cecho("\n<DodgerBlue> Best appeal calculated to be: <yellow>"..bestResult.." <DodgerBlue>(<orange>"..bestValue.."<DodgerBlue>)") send("qeb appeal to "..bestResult,false) else PersuasionCalcsPriority(sameValues) end end

Script.name: Persuasion Helper Funcs
Script.script:
function PersuasionEcho(text) cecho("\n<sienna>(<goldenrod>PERSUASION<sienna>): <DarkSlateGrey>"..text) end
function PersuasionMoralityCheck() local count = 0 for _, appeal in pairs(Persuasion.Current_Appeals) do if Persuasion.Attacks[appeal:title()] == Persuasion.Bane then count = count + 1 end end return count >= 2 end
function PersuasionCalcsPriority(appeals) --A default list of priorities, feel free to change around. local PersuasionPriorities = { "Morality", -- Get more appeals sooner/often. "Reason", -- Won't ever have to choose between Reason and Morality. "Reputation", -- Influence is never a bad option. "Tradition", -- Good damage, probably won't ever have to choose. "Inspiration", -- Faster cycling. --"Evidence", -- More vulns are nice. "Intimidation", -- Middling effects. "Reassurance", -- Shared Pathos appeal. "Causality", -- Crits aren't as important as a priority draw. "Authority", -- Negligible effect as a priority draw. "Provocation", -- If we're tied here, it should be last priority. } --This is only ever gonna be used for when we have multiple actions with same weighting.
--We're only gonna add Evidence if they're not already vulnerable to the booned tree. if not table.contains(Persuasion.Evidence, Persuasion.Boon) then table.insert(PersuasionPriorities, 6, "Evidence") end
cecho("\n<green> Needing to choose between: <orange>"..table.concat(appeals, ", ")..".") for _, appeal in pairs(PersuasionPriorities) do --We choose the highest priority of ones in the table. if table.contains(appeals, appeal) then cecho("\n<DodgerBlue> --> <yellow>"..appeal.." has highest priority.") send("qeb appeal to "..appeal,false) break end end end

Script.name: Persuasion Target Management
Script.script:
function Persuasion.CheckRoom() if not Persuasion.Areas or not Persuasion.Areas[gmcp.Room.Info.area] then return end
Persuasion.CanPersuade = {} for ind, details in pairs(gmcp.Char.Items.List.items) do if table.contains(Persuasion.Areas[gmcp.Room.Info.area], details.name) and details.attrib ~= "mC" then table.insert(Persuasion.CanPersuade, details.id) end end end registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Items", "Persuasion.CheckRoom")
function Persuasion.AddMob(area, mob) Persuasion.Areas = Persuasion.Areas or {} Persuasion.Areas[area] = Persuasion.Areas[area] or {} if not table.contains(Persuasion.Areas[area], mob) then table.insert(Persuasion.Areas[area], mob) PersuasionEcho("Added "..mob.." to persuasion targets in "..area..".") end end
function Persuasion.RemMob(area, mob) Persuasion.Areas = Persuasion.Areas or {} Persuasion.Areas[area] = Persuasion.Areas[area] or {} for i,d in pairs(Persuasion.Areas[area]) do if (d==mob) or string.starts(d, mob) or string.find(d, mob) then table.remove(Persuasion.Areas[area], i) PersuasionEcho("Removed "..d.." from persuasion targets in "..area..".") end end end
function Persuasion.Save() local separator = string.char(getMudletHomeDir():byte()) == "/" and "/" or "\\" local PerFile = getMudletHomeDir()..separator.."PersuasionList" if Persuasion.Areas then table.save(PerFile, Persuasion.Areas) PersuasionEcho("Saved persuasion targets to: "..PerFile..".") end end
function Persuasion.Load() local separator = string.char(getMudletHomeDir():byte()) == "/" and "/" or "\\" local PerFile = getMudletHomeDir()..separator.."PersuasionList" if io.exists(PerFile) then Persuasion.Areas = {} table.load(PerFile, Persuasion.Areas) end end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDisconnectionEvent", "Persuasion.Save", true) registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysLoadEvent", "Persuasion.Load")
